description_for_human: Privacy-first customer support and issue tracking portal. Submit issues and track replies via secret links.
description_for_model: Nullbox is a customer support ticket system. Use POST /api/tickets to submit a new support ticket (subject, body, severity p1-p4, optional customer_name and customer_email). Use GET /api/public/tickets/{id} with header X-Ticket-Token to read a customer's ticket thread, or GET /api/tickets and PATCH /api/tickets/{id} with header X-Actor-Name to triage tickets as a support worker. Full documentation is at /llms.txt and /openapi.json.
